checked: scripts/ci_core.sh on a checkout with maturin absent and VIRTUAL_ENV unset
runtime_smokes.correction: The first three were originally recorded as passing while the author's shell was inside a virtualenv. `maturin develop` requires one and fails without it, so `make setup` and ci_core.sh were broken for any reader outside a venv - which public CI then proved. Both now use `maturin build` + `pip install`, and are re-verified with VIRTUAL_ENV unset. The README first example was separately found to crash and the README was corrected; it is not claimed as a passing smoke.

negative_fixtures.note: An earlier value of this field read '6 injected violations'. That was the first round only and contradicted check_qualification in this same file; 32 is the measured count. See check_qualification.

meaning: PASS means no release-blocking finding under this named profile, NOT global cleanliness.

content_identity.method: full git commit id + full git tree id + content manifest root
content_identity.manifest_root: sha256 over sorted records of "path\0mode\0sha256(file bytes | symlink target)"
content_identity.note: A digest over file NAMES alone does not bind content and must not be used.

supported_ci_surface.entrypoint: scripts/ci_core.sh (shared by local checkout, CI, external reproducers)
covers: maturin build --release --features python + pip install the wheel
does_not_cover: full legacy test suite (22 known collection errors)

check_qualification.note: "Wired" means the check exists. "Qualified" means a fixture injecting the violation was proven to BLOCK. An earlier report said "17 classes"; the real count is 24 check() calls plus ~11 inline checks.
check_qualification.not_qualified_rationale: These three are non-blocking hygiene checks (stale scrub artifacts, one phantom name form, self-declared MIT). Every check that gates a hard blocker — secrets, PII, machine identity, private keys, licence, identity — is fixture-qualified.

bypass_fixtures.F3: AWS key inside the exempt checker file still BLOCKS
bypass_fixtures.F5: over-claim in any other file still BLOCKS

full_profile.why: This artifact is maintenance-only. Publishing and maintaining the checker here would add a second active codebase to a frozen artifact. The public claim was sized down instead.
